checks.name: engine_meter_files_exist
command: test -f Source/DSP/MeterTap.h && test -f Source/DSP/MeterTap.cpp && test -f Source/DSP/ShredWidthEngine.h && test -f Source/DSP/ShredWidthEngine.cpp && test -f tests/EngineTests.cpp && test -f Source/PluginProcessor.cpp

checks.name: engine_meter_symbols_present
command: rg -q 'class\s+MeterTap' Source/DSP/MeterTap.h && rg -q 'class\s+ShredWidthEngine' Source/DSP/ShredWidthEngine.h && rg -q 'std::atomic' Source/DSP/MeterTap.h Source/DSP/MeterTap.cpp && rg -q 'AbstractFifo' Source/DSP/MeterTap.h Source/DSP/MeterTap.cpp && rg -q 'getReportedLatencySamples|setLatencyMode' Source/DSP/ShredWidthEngine.h Source/DSP/ShredWidthEngine.cpp && rg -q 'ScopedNoDenormals' Source/PluginProcessor.cpp

checks.name: cmake_registers_engine_meter_tests
command: rg -q 'MeterTap\.cpp' CMakeLists.txt && rg -q 'ShredWidthEngine\.cpp' CMakeLists.txt && rg -q 'EngineTests\.cpp' CMakeLists.txt

checks.name: processblock_engine_wiring_present
command: rg -q 'ShredWidthEngine' Source/PluginProcessor.h Source/PluginProcessor.cpp && rg -q 'setLatencySamples' Source/PluginProcessor.cpp && rg -q 'updateHostDisplay' Source/PluginProcessor.cpp

checks.name: engine_tests_cover_key_invariants
command: rg -q 'Mix|mix' tests/EngineTests.cpp && rg -q 'latency|1024|256' tests/EngineTests.cpp && rg -q 'mono|width|L.*R' tests/EngineTests.cpp
